title: Cloudflare
intro: What Cloudflare offers and its API: DNS and CDN, Workers and storage, security, Zero Trust, and the tools to manage them.
scope: A summary of what is available, not a replacement for the docs, which cover well over a hundred products. Plans and prices are left out. Cloudflare is a commercial service with a free tier; Wrangler, cloudflared and the provider are open source.

sections.title: What it does
items: In front: a domain's DNS points at Cloudflare, which proxies traffic: [DNS](#dns), [Cache](#cache), [SSL/TLS](#ssl-tls), [WAF](#waf).

Behind: [Workers](#workers) run code at the edge. Storage and messaging products attach to a Worker as bindings: [KV](#kv), [R2](#r2), [D1](#d1), [Durable Objects](#durable-objects), [Queues](#queues), [Hyperdrive](#hyperdrive), [Workflows](#workflows).
Private access: [Tunnel](#tunnel) connects an origin without a public IP, and [Cloudflare One](#cloudflare-one) controls who reaches internal and SaaS apps.
Manage it with [Wrangler](#wrangler), the [API](#api), the [Terraform provider](#terraform) or the dashboard.
Not covered, one line each: Pages, Images, Stream, Realtime, AI products (Workers AI, AI Gateway, Vectorize, Agents), Magic Transit and BYOIP, 1.1.1.1 and Radar. The full list is the docs index.

rows: Holds Workers, storage, tokens and Zero Trust settings.
One domain on Cloudflare: DNS records, cache, TLS, WAF and rules.
Code that runs on Cloudflare. Bindings give it access to other products.
A scoped credential for the API, Wrangler and Terraform.

sections.title: What it does
items: Authenticate with an API token (preferred). The legacy Global API key works but has limitations, and Origin CA keys are separate.
The global limit is 1,200 requests per five minutes per user, whatever the way in. Over it, every call for five minutes gets 429.
Responses carry Ratelimit, Ratelimit-Policy and, when limited, retry-after headers. Cloudflare's SDKs back off automatically.

rows: by query cost, at most 320 per 5 minutes
50 user tokens per user, 500 account tokens per account

sections.title: What it does
items: Deploy JavaScript, TypeScript or other supported languages and route requests to them. Static assets can be served with the Worker.
Limits depend on the plan. Free: 100,000 requests a day, 10 ms CPU time, 50 subrequests per request. Paid: no request limit, 5 minutes CPU time, 10,000 subrequests. Memory is 128 MB on both.
